title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion - University of California on 1971-11-20
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> VXPocket v2 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Studio‑clarity soundboard capture of the tight November 1971 Pauley Pavilion show, highlighted by a smoking Truckin→Not Fade Away jam and crisp overall mix.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its near‑studio clarity, great instrument separation and stereo depth – an exceptional soundboard (or matrix) source despite occasional patches.  Musically the performance is described as tight, energetic and orchestrated, with standout jams like Truckin into Not Fade Away and a memorable Sugar Magnolia false start, while newcomer Keith Godchaux’s inspired playing adds extra fire.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.1, with the majority praising both performance and sound quality; weighting favors strong show quality and excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note studio‑like clarity, superb tone separation and a clean stereo mix; occasional minor patches are mentioned but overall the audio is crisp and well balanced, likely a soundboard with post‑mix enhancement (possible matrix).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight and orchestrated performance with seamless transitions; the band moves confidently through the set, delivering high‑energy jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is highlighted as great and studio‑like in the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Newcomer Keith Godchaux (piano/keys) receives praise for tight, energetic playing.
